title: Nerrivik
culture_region: グリーンランド(イヌイット)
text:
A bird once wished to marry a woman.  He got himself a fine sealskin
coat, and having weak eyes, made spectacles out of a walrus tusk,
for he was greatly set upon looking as nice as possible.  Then he
set off, in the shape of a man, and coming to a village, took a wife,
and brought her home.

Now he began to go out catching fish, which he called seal, and
brought home to his wife.

Once it happened that he lost his spectacles, and his wife, seeing
his bad eyes, burst out weeping, because he was so ugly.

But her husband only laughed. "Oho, so you saw my eyes? Hahaha!"
And he put on his spectacles again.

Then her brothers, who longed for their sister, came out one day
to visit her. And her husband being out hunting, they took her away
with them. The husband was greatly distressed when he came home and
found her gone, and thinking someone must have carried her off, he
set out in pursuit. He swung his wings with mighty force, and raised
a violent storm, for he was a great wizard.

When the storm came up, the boat began to take in water, and the wind
grew fiercer, as he doubled the beating of his wings. The waves rose
white with foam, and the boat was near turning over. And when those in
the boat began to suspect that the woman was the cause of the storm,
they took her up and cast her into the sea. She tried to grasp the side
of the boat, but then her grandfather sprang up and cut off her hand.

And so she was drowned. But at the bottom of the sea, she became
Nerrivik, the ruler over all the creatures in the sea. And when men
catch no seal, then the wizards go down to Nerrivik.  Having but one
hand, she cannot comb her hair, and this they do for her, and she,
by way of thanks, sends seal and other creatures forth to men.

That is the story of the ruler of the sea.  And men call her Nerrivik
[11] because she gives them food.

Then he set off, in the shape of a man, and coming to a village, took a wife, and brought her home.
Now he began to go out catching fish, which he called seal, and brought home to his wife.
Once it happened that he lost his spectacles, and his wife, seeing his bad eyes, burst out weeping, because he was so ugly.
But her husband only laughed. "Oho, so you saw my eyes? Hahaha!" And he put on his spectacles again.

Then her brothers, who longed for their sister, came out one day to visit her. And her husband being out hunting, they took her away with them. The husband was greatly distressed when he came home and found her gone, and thinking someone must have carried her off, he set out in pursuit. He swung his wings with mighty force, and raised a violent storm, for he was a great wizard.

When the storm came up, the boat began to take in water, and the wind grew fiercer, as he doubled the beating of his wings. The waves rose white with foam, and the boat was near turning over. And when those in the boat began to suspect that the woman was the cause of the storm, they took her up and cast her into the sea. And so she was drowned. But at the bottom of the sea, she became Nerrivik, the ruler over all the creatures in the sea. And when men catch no seal, then the wizards go down to Nerrivik.  Having but one hand, she cannot comb her hair, and this they do for her, and she, by way of thanks, sends seal and other creatures forth to men.
That is the story of the ruler of the sea.  And men call her Nerrivik [11] because she gives them food.
むかし、一羽の鳥が女をめとりたいと思った。鳥は立派なアザラシの毛皮の上着を手に入れ、目が弱かったので、セイウチの牙で眼鏡をこしらえた。できるだけ見栄えよく見せようと、たいそう熱心だったのである。それから鳥は人の姿になって出かけ、ある村に来て妻をめとり、家へ連れて帰った。
さて鳥は魚をとりに出かけるようになり、それをアザラシだと言って妻のところへ持ち帰った。
あるとき鳥は眼鏡をなくしてしまった。妻は夫の悪い目を見ると、夫があまりに醜いので泣きだした。
けれども夫は笑うばかりだった。「おほう、わたしの目を見たのかい。はっはっは!」そしてまた眼鏡をかけた。
それから、妹を恋しがっていた女の兄弟たちが、ある日女を訪ねてやって来た。そして夫が狩りに出ていたので、兄弟たちは女を連れていってしまった。夫は家に帰って妻がいないのに気づくとたいそう取り乱し、誰かが連れ去ったにちがいないと思って、あとを追いかけた。夫は力いっぱい翼を振るって、激しい嵐を起こした。夫は偉大な魔法使いだったのである。
嵐が来ると舟に水が入りはじめ、夫が翼を打つのを倍にしたので、風はいっそう激しくなった。波は白く泡立って高くなり、舟はいまにもひっくり返りそうになった。そして舟に乗っていた者たちは、女が嵐のもとではないかと疑いはじめ、女を抱え上げて海に投げ込んだ。女は舟べりにつかまろうとしたが、そのとき女の祖父が飛び上がって女の手を切り落とした。
こうして女は溺れた。けれども海の底で、女は海のあらゆる生き物を治めるネリヴィクになった。そして人がアザラシをとれないときには、魔法使いたちがネリヴィクのもとへ降りていく。ネリヴィクは片手しかないので髪をとかすことができない。魔法使いたちがそれをしてやると、ネリヴィクはお礼に、アザラシやほかの生き物を人のもとへ送り出してくれるのである。
これが海を治める者の話である。そして人は彼女をネリヴィク[11]と呼ぶ。食べ物を与えてくれるからである。
